verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Unity documents a public scripting API (unity-docs-11) and editor extension APIs (unity-docs-10), so documented APIs exist. However, docs.unity3d.com has no llms.txt and no markdown mirrors (unity-probe-1, unity-probe-2, unity-probe-rt-2), so the core reference docs are not machine-readable for models. Nothing in the pack speaks to API stability across versions, the volume of public code examples, or how often LLM-generated Unity code works on the first try. missing for 10: evidence of API stability across versions, evidence of abundant public examples/training data, hands-on reports of LLM-generated Unity code succeeding first try, machine-readable API reference docs.
